glassmaker.words: Welcome, little one. Come in, come in. This is my town, and these are my memories, kept in glass.

child.words: A long time ago, a big rock was falling from the sky. So the old glassman made magic glass.

glass.en.text: So my glass found someone. Good.
glass.en.instruct: Speak low and calm, quietly glad, like an old man in the dark.

glass.de.text: Mein Glas hat also jemanden gefunden. Gut.
